title: Fleet - Overview
description: Simple fleet status snapshot: availability, overall pipe consistency, overall provider consistency, operational risks, stores, brokers, consumers, and topics. No time-series panels.

panels.title: Broker Availability
panels.description: Percentage of configured POS brokers currently reachable by Prometheus.

panels.title: Stores
panels.description: Configured stores represented by fleet broker targets.

panels.title: Consumer Availability
panels.description: Percentage of configured consumer processes currently reachable.

panels.title: Messages In / sec
panels.description: Fleet-wide broker receive rate over the last five minutes.

panels.title: Storage Used
panels.description: Current broker storage bytes summed across the POS fleet.

panels.title: Fetch p95
panels.description: 95th percentile HTTP fetch latency from each broker to its upstream source.

panels.title: Broker Store Avg
panels.description: Average broker receive-to-local-store handling time over five minutes. This is not consumer end-to-end latency.

panels.title: Max Consumer Lag
panels.description: Largest current consumer lag reported by any broker consumer group.

panels.title: Overall Pipe Consistency
panels.description: Percentage of all reported provider-topic audits that are consistent. Inconsistent and unverified results both reduce this fleet score.

panels.title: Overall Provider Consistency
panels.description: Percentage of configured POS providers that are online and whose every reported topic is verified and consistent.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(min by (store_id, host_id) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 0) * on (store_id, host_id) up{job="fleet-brokers"}) / clamp_min(count(up{job="fleet-brokers"}), 1)

panels.title: Consistent Providers
panels.description: Online POS providers whose every reported topic is verified and consistent.

targets.expr: sum(min by (store_id, host_id) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 0) * on (store_id, host_id) up{job="fleet-brokers"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unverified Providers
panels.description: POS providers with at least one reported topic that the latest audit could not verify.

targets.expr: sum(max by (store_id, host_id) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 2)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Inconsistent Topics
panels.description: Unique topics inconsistent on one or more brokers.

targets.expr: sum((sum by (topic) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 1)) > bool 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unverified Topics
panels.description: Unique topics unverified on one or more brokers.

targets.expr: sum((sum by (topic) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 2)) > bool 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Verified Coverage
panels.description: Percentage of broker-topic checks with a definitive consistent or inconsistent result.

panels.title: Oldest Audit Age
panels.description: Time since the least recently completed broker-topic consistency audit.

panels.title: Brokers Offline
panels.description: Configured fleet broker targets currently unreachable.

panels.title: Consumers Offline
panels.description: Configured fleet consumer processes currently unreachable.

panels.title: Backpressured Channels
panels.description: Broker network channels currently blocked by backpressure.

panels.title: Critical Heap Brokers
panels.description: Brokers currently reporting critical JVM heap pressure.

panels.title: Aborted Refresh Topics
panels.description: Broker-topic refresh workflows whose current state is ABORTED.

panels.title: Active Compactions
panels.description: Topic compactions currently running across the fleet.

panels.title: Store Health (click Store)
panels.description: One row per store. Availability and verification coverage are intentionally separate.

targets.expr: sum by (store_id) (min by (store_id, host_id) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 0) * on (store_id, host_id) up{job="fleet-brokers"})
sum by (store_id) ((sum by (store_id, topic) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 1)) > bool 0)
sum by (store_id) ((sum by (store_id, topic) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 2)) > bool 0)

panels.title: Broker Health (click Host)
panels.description: Every configured broker is listed, including offline, inconsistent, and unverified brokers.

targets.expr: (max by (store_id, host_id) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 1)) + 2 * ((max by (store_id, host_id) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 1) == bool 0) * max by (store_id, host_id) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 2))
100 * sum by (store_id, host_id) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} != bool 2) / clamp_min(count by (store_id, host_id) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"}), 1)

panels.title: Consumer Health
panels.description: Availability and delivery health grouped by consumer type across all stores.

panels.title: Topic Health (worst state across fleet)
panels.description: Worst audit state and detected key problems for each topic across all brokers.

targets.expr: (sum by (topic) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 1) > bool 0) + 2 * ((sum by (topic) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 1) == bool 0) * (sum by (topic) (pipe_consistency_state{job="fleet-brokers"} == bool 2) > bool 0))
